name: @marxy/desktop
description: The desktop shell (Tauri) and app UI.

scripts.build: vite build && tauri build --no-bundle && node scripts/smoke-cli-open.mjs
scripts.test: node --test --test-concurrency=1 --experimental-strip-types 'src/palette/*.test.ts' 'src/source/*.test.mjs' 'src/startup/*.test.mjs' 'test/**/*.test.mjs' 'scripts/**/*.test.mjs' && ( MARXY_86_MUTATION=search-prepared-body node --test --test-concurrency=1 --experimental-strip-types src/palette/session.test.ts src/palette/search.test.ts src/palette/search-perf.test.ts src/palette/keys.test.ts ; test $? -eq 1 )
